name: armada-ai
description: Armada in VS Code: connect to your Armada Admiral, navigate every Armada area, and work the mission and voyage black box (failures, FIX THIS briefs, recovery, timelines, attempt diffs, overlap previews, conflict decorations) with live updates.

armada.tenant.description: Optional tenant id (ten_...). Admin credentials use it to narrow lists to one tenant; other credentials are already scoped to their own tenant.

armada.dashboardUrl.description: Armada dashboard URL used for dashboard links and Ask Armada. Empty means Harbor's configured dashboard for Harbor's Admiral, else the connected Admiral followed by /dashboard.

armada.fixThis.openPreview.description: Open a Markdown preview beside the FIX THIS editor.

armada.failures.showInExplorer.description: Also show the Armada Failures view in the Explorer (it always appears in the Armada view container).

armada.failures.filterToWorkspaceVessel.description: Show only entries for the vessel whose repository (git remote URL) is open. Falls back to every vessel when none matches.

armada.failures.includeResolved.description: Also list resolved entries in the Armada Failures view.

armada.liveUpdates.useWebSocket.description: Listen for black box events on the Armada WebSocket. When the socket is unavailable the extension polls.

armada.liveUpdates.pollIntervalSeconds.description: Polling interval used when the WebSocket is disabled or down.

armada.decorations.enabled.description: Decorate files that conflicted in open entries and the vessel's hotspot directories.

armada.decorations.hotspotLimit.description: Number of hotspot directories to decorate (0 turns hotspot decorations off).

armada.notifications.onCapture.description: Show a notification when a black box entry is captured for the open repository's vessel.

armada.notifications.needsYou.description: Show a notification when something new needs you (a review, a failure, a CLI permission request, an alert).

armada.language.description: Language of Armada's labels in the views, pages and forms, from the Admiral's translation catalog. "auto" follows VS Code's display language.
